:::{#exr-data-splits}
#### Sizes of a three-way split

The `mtcars` data frame has $\nobs = 32$ cars.
Suppose we assign $\lfloor 0.6 \nobs \rfloor$ cars to a training set,
$\lfloor 0.2 \nobs \rfloor$ cars to a validation set,
and all remaining cars to a test set.
How many cars are in each set?

:::
